description: This file contains Redux selectors for the Mattermost admin console, including functions to retrieve admin definitions, custom components and sections, console access permissions, and user management settings visibility based on license and permissions.

methods.name: getAdminDefinition
methods.description: Creates a selector to retrieve and deep clone the admin console definition, applying reducers to modify it.

methods.name: getAdminConsoleCustomComponents
methods.description: Retrieves custom components for the admin console for a specific plugin ID.

methods.name: getAdminConsoleCustomSections
methods.description: Retrieves custom sections for the admin console for a specific plugin ID.

methods.name: getConsoleAccess
methods.description: Creates a selector to determine read/write access permissions for console resources based on system permissions and admin definition.

methods.name: getShowManageUserSettings
methods.description: Creates a selector to determine if the 'Manage User Settings' option should be shown, based on license type and permissions.

methods.name: getShowLockedManageUserSettings
methods.description: Creates a selector to determine if the 'Locked Manage User Settings' option should be shown, based on license type and permissions.
